title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply — Swing Bandwidth Schedule
content:
On Commercial Natural Gas Supply, swing is the billing of usage that falls outside a bandwidth around the site's monthly contract volume. Whether a plan bills swing at all, how wide its bandwidth is and what it charges outside the band are fixed plan by plan as follows.

## Bandwidth terms

| Plan | Swing billed separately | Swing tolerance (percent) | Excess adder over the monthly index (USD per therm) | Shortfall charge (USD per therm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | No | 0 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | No | 0 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Yes | 20 | 0.0400 | 0.0600 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Yes | 20 | 0.0400 | 0.0600 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Yes | 25 | 0.0400 | 0.0600 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Yes | 20 | 0.0400 | 0.0600 |

## Measurement terms

| Plan | Period over which usage is compared | How the monthly contract volume is derived | Bandwidth measured across the business's portfolio | Annual volume true-up billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | Billing cycle | Contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | Billing cycle | Contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Billing cycle | Contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Billing cycle | Contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm | Yes | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Billing cycle | Contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm | Yes | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Billing cycle | Contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm | Yes | No |

## Notes

- The Monthly Index and Fixed Basis 12 plans do not bill swing separately; their tolerance, excess adder and shortfall charge are shown as zero.
- Among the plans that bill swing, the Fixed 36 plan has the widest tolerance at 25 percent; the Fixed 12, Fixed 24 and Carbon Neutral 24 plans have 20 percent.
- The excess adder is a per-therm amount over the month's delivered index price; the shortfall charge is a per-therm amount on therms of shortfall.
- Portfolio bandwidth is a feature of the Fixed 24, Fixed 36 and Carbon Neutral 24 plans only. The Fixed 12 plan bills swing but always measures the site on its own.
- No plan bills an annual true-up of total usage against contract volume.

## Illustration (hypothetical contract volume)

A site contracted for 14,400 therms a year has a monthly contract volume of 1,200 therms on every plan, because 14,400 divided by 12 is exactly 1,200. A contract of 14,410 therms a year gives 1,200.83 before rounding, so the monthly contract volume is 1,201 therms.
